title: Felt Cognition: Parallel Micro-Eddies, the Stream of Thought, and the Open Problem of Experience
paper_class: frontier (model + large open register; no causal anchor)
abstract: A functional model of the stream of thought on the verified neuro chain. A thought is many parallel ionic eddies igniting in γ (winner-take-most); the basal-ganglia loop selects one; a dopamine error shapes which eddies are laid down next; serial selection bound within a θ frame is the stream. The 'field' is band-structured phase-coherence on ionic spikes and synaptic currents (CTC), not a physical field. The embodied real-time loop is proposed as felt cognition; whether it is experience is open. No link is causal; the hard problem is deferred, not solved.

chapters.title: Constitution and scope
chapters.one_liner: What this paper reads (the functional stream of thought, present-tense), the physical-mediator discipline, the one-way dependency on neuro, and the hard problem held open.

chapters.title: The retired field, and what replaces it
chapters.one_liner: The earlier EM field, the coherence-length rejection (corrected — it was the quantum case; the classical field is coherent across the brain, so its medium role is open), and the named mechanism that replaces it: ion spikes and synaptic currents, gated by classified low-frequency phase (CTC). Locked by regime: EM is never retired wholesale — only the radiative far-field/optical-fibre carrier is; the near-field/ephaptic form is affirmed at threshold (neuro §18–§19), with only its functional use open (EM_NEAR_FAR_THESIS.md).

chapters.title: Brain organs from 4D-DNA
chapters.one_liner: The substrate is emerged, not assumed: each organ's master gene sets a measured bistable γ, and from γ alone the engine predicts the commit order — hypothalamus, cerebellum, cerebrum, hippocampus. Absolute size stays open.

chapters.title: The EM brainwave, emerged
chapters.one_liner: Excitatory and inhibitory populations make a theta–gamma local field radiated through the wave equation; the emitted front travels at the wave speed c and the field is coherent across the brain, so the old coherence-length rejection (a quantum number) fails. Whether it is the computational medium turns on field strength and stays open.

chapters.title: How memory remembers
chapters.one_liner: Memory is a physical attractor: a Hebbian write deepens an engram cell's well until it completes from a tenth of a cue; the theta brainwave is the clock, and writing and retrieving on opposite phases measurably protects old memory.

chapters.title: Parallel micro-eddies
chapters.one_liner: A thought is many local ionic γ-assemblies laid down in parallel; the competition is winner-take-most, γ sets ignitability, and absolute size and consciousness are open.

chapters.title: Selection: the closed loop
chapters.one_liner: Among the parallel eddies, one is selected by the basal-ganglia action-selection loop of the neuro chain; the carried (most-ignited) eddy wins, γ predicts the delay.

chapters.title: The laid-down field is learned
chapters.one_liner: Which eddies get laid down is itself learned: a selection outcome makes a dopamine reward-prediction error that updates which eddies appear next — the system learns what to think.

chapters.title: The stream of thought
chapters.one_liner: The stream is serial selection — one eddy then the next, with conflict, memory feedback, and a global γ synchrony binding the contents; the 'large field' is θ–γ phase-coherence.

chapters.title: The embodied feeling loop
chapters.one_liner: Body and brain form one loop; the real-time feeling loop proposes consciousness is this integrated eddy process — but whether the loop is experience, or only correlates with it, is open.

chapters.title: Hemispheres, and why thought is not feeling
chapters.one_liner: Hemispheric asymmetry is graded, not the folk myth; and a system can run the stream's computation yet lack the embodied real-time loop and experience — an architectural hypothesis.

chapters.title: The open problem of experience
chapters.one_liner: The standing reference: the honest negative on the access marker, the open register (access, the hard problem, the quale), and the irreversible retired register.

chapters.title: Inter-organ coordination by the ephaptic field
chapters.one_liner: Eight brain organs, each with a measured master-gene identity and a cited rhythm, coupled only by the measured ephaptic near-field (~1/r^3, at the entrainment threshold; neuro 18-19), settle into partial, metastable coordination. The cancel-vs-augment test run in silico shows the field causally contributes coordination, opens CTC windows, carries theta-gamma PAC, and supports a traveling wave [verified mechanism]; whether cognition uses it is open.

chapters.title: Sensory inflow — what the measured field binds
chapters.one_liner: Eight sensory streams covering the nine modalities (one skin organ carries touch, warmth and high-threshold pain), each with a master-gene identity read verbatim from the neuro chain and a cited rhythm, couple to their anatomical central relay at the SAME measured ephaptic strength (kappa=0.55, no new constant). Sensory drive loads onto the central field without seizing it (anchor R unchanged = frozen M9); distinct senses bind cross-modally only through that shared field (cancel < measured < augment, co-relay control flat) [verified mechanism]; whether cognition uses it is open.

chapters.title: Light to memory — how emerged light writes an engram
chapters.one_liner: On the same vacuum lattice a brainwave is emerged light; brainwave and sensory EM superpose, and geometric angle rectification (alpha = 2/pi single, delta = 1/pi^2 double, with 2*pi = alpha/delta) turns their signed, self-cancelling phase overlap into a sign-surviving information bit. A bound pair rectifies to 1/4, an unbound pair to the floor delta; the contrast clears the R19 engram fold and writes a persisting memory under a theta write-clock. Six informations roll through gamma slots in one theta frame, all recovered, and a downstream neuron feels the rolled field. Verified in-silico mechanism; biological use stays open.

chapters.title: What a thought is — the definition that closes the paper
chapters.one_liner: The closing chapter defines the paper's central word. A thought is the union of fourteen mental faculties, not an abstract umbrella; mechanically, serial selection among parallel ionic gamma-eddies bound within a theta frame, running on a substrate emerged from 4D-DNA (organs, brainwave and memory generated, not assumed). The everyday felt stream is recovered as a fast chain of discrete selections. Closed on the mechanism axis; whether any of it is felt is a separate, orthogonal question left open.

chapters.title: The faculties of mind — thought decomposed into fourteen faculties
chapters.one_liner: The atlas behind the closing definition. Thought is partitioned into fourteen faculties: ten (perception, attention, the serial stream, memory, learning, the affect mechanism, arousal/sleep, dreaming, large-scale binding, pathology) are built, frozen and bit-reproducible; four (language, volition, social cognition, metacognition) are honestly owed with named external inputs. The partition is run against the standard neurocognitive domains so it cannot be gerrymandered, and the dream worked example shows why thought is the umbrella and cognition one room under it. Closed on the mechanism axis; the felt axis stays orthogonal.

chapters.title: Autism as a three-axis fault — threshold, gain, and wiring
chapters.one_liner: Autism read on the emerged cerebrum as three separable faults — a threshold/E-I fault (T), an output/gain fault (O), and a long-range wiring fault (W). The pair (ΔPAC, ignition fold) uniquely fingerprints each and reproduces under SEED=19. Which fault any individual's autism is, is held open. efficacy=0; not a diagnosis.

chapters.title: What a chemical can and cannot reach — mask versus correction
chapters.one_liner: On the three-axis model, a scalar threshold-lowering (gain) chemical — the stimulant-class mechanism — fully reverses the T fault, partly helps O, and only masks W by over-synchronisation, because scalar gain cannot re-route geometry. The engine's account of why a stimulant relieves some autism and not others. efficacy=0; no drug-treats-autism claim.

chapters.title: The θ-cap — an external pacemaker for the wiring axis
chapters.one_liner: The keystone disorder chapter. On the wiring-faulted cohort only a coherence-forcing external clock routes (inj 0.08–0.10; over-sync past 0.15); every passive additive lane is inert, so the benign-lane reframing is refuted. The cap is cleanly removable (no plasticity, no dependence) and molecularly safe below the spinodal fold — a pacemaker, not a repair.

chapters.title: The θ-cap operating principle — and whether it is physically buildable
chapters.one_liner: If a θ-cap is to supply the wiring-axis function at all, the dynamics force one mode: minimum-effective, deficit-matched amplitude, applied continuously — nothing is banked. Paired with a physical-feasibility review: every component (theta-tACS, closed-loop phase-locking, multi-electrode long-range montages) exists today, the specific assembly does not, and feasibility is not benefit. efficacy=0.

chapters.title: ADHD — and why it separates from autism
chapters.one_liner: An explicit gene-grounded ADHD substrate (six gain/output genes, two arousal/threshold genes, wiring=none) emerged on the same engine. A stimulant restores ADHD to health where it only partly reaches autism; the cap is 3.3× more wiring-selective; on an AuDHD substrate the two compose without interference. Why severe ADHD can look like autism, and why it is not. ADHD model validity open.

chapters.title: The virtual trial — who the model says responds, and who does not
chapters.one_liner: A synthetic population of 80 emerged cerebra (76 affected) with sampled fault mixes, run under stimulant, cap, and both. Responders are gain-dominated, non-responders wiring-dominated and partly cap-rescuable; an honest refutation shows the cap-unrescued residual is a dose-cap/stiffness limit, not a severe-wiring tail. Every fraction is an in-silico coupling state. efficacy=0.

chapters.title: Schizophrenia — the over-ignition mirror of autism
chapters.one_liner: Schizophrenia as the over-ignition mirror of autism-T on the same R19 ignitability axis: a disinhibitory bias lowers the fold so weak, irrelevant assemblies ignite (aberrant salience), where autism-T raises the fold and loses relevant ones. Its positive, negative and cognitive symptoms map onto the threshold, output and wiring axes, and a single gain-reducing antipsychotic operator reverses the positive domain only — a mechanistic account of why dopamine blockade relieves positive but not negative or cognitive symptoms. efficacy=0.

chapters.title: Epilepsy — the over-synchronisation pole
chapters.one_liner: Epilepsy as the over-synchronisation pole of the engine synchrony axis: an excitatory bias drives the global order parameter to the over-sync ceiling and the selective gate collapses, so every candidate assembly ignites — the ictal state (loss of gating). On one axis autism-T (under-ignited) < health (selective) < schizophrenia (aberrant) < epilepsy (all ignited); an inhibitory anticonvulsant-class push reverses it and raises the seizure threshold. The static susceptibility is characterised; the ictal time-course is owed to a state-switching layer (E2). efficacy=0.

chapters.title: The plasticity layer — consolidation and chronification
chapters.one_liner: The plasticity / consolidation layer the structural atlas never had: a slow phase-correlation Hebbian update of the ephaptic kernel (W_ij ← max(0, W_ij(1+η·C_ij)), C_ij = <cos(θ_j−θ_i)>; form forced, rate η open and signs swept). It makes consolidation and stimulation after-effects representable (E0.1), RESOLVES the open continuous-vs-periodic dosing question — spaced dosing leaves a larger retained structural trace than massed, so the cap repairs and pacing beats holding (E0.2) — and builds the reversible→chronified switch every temporal disorder needs: η=0 reverts, η>0 retains (E0.3). With η=0 it reproduces the frozen M9 anchor bit-for-bit (E0.4), a pure add-on. The layer, not a disorder; depression/bipolar/addiction import its substrate. efficacy=0.

chapters.title: Depression and treatment resistance — the chronification of a low-coordination operating point
chapters.one_liner: The first temporal disorder, built on the plasticity layer (it imports PlasticConnectome rather than re-deriving the rule). Major depression as the chronification of a low-coordination operating point: the engine's own HPA/stress axis (M18 cortisol + M17 valence) drives a sustained withdrawal bias that lowers coordination below health (acute, reversible), and with plasticity the excursion writes a retained structural trace that does not revert — the reversible→chronified switch. Antidepressant delayed onset is a consolidation timescale, treatment resistance is the depth of the trace; no new constant, η=0/stress=0 reproduces the frozen M9 anchor bit-for-bit. efficacy=0; not medical advice.

chapters.title: The state-switching layer — hysteresis, the fold, and the ictal time-course
chapters.one_liner: The fast counterpart to the plasticity layer: the R19 bistable cell ṡ = g·s − s³ + h read OVER TIME, with no new equation and no free constant (g=1.0 universal scale, fold = the engine's own spinodal(g), grids swept anti-tuning). Four results: hysteresis (loop width 2·spinodal≈0.77 — a state resists switching back); a transition latency that diverges at the fold (critical slowing) and falls with overshoot, CLOSING the §25 ictal time-course owed to E2; the barrier as switching threshold (shallow wells flip, deep wells hold); and const-drive integration reproducing the engine's settle bit-for-bit. The layer, not a disorder. efficacy=0.

chapters.title: Bipolar disorder — two poles on one axis, episodes as bistable switches
chapters.one_liner: The second temporal disorder and the first to use the state-switching layer: it IMPORTS both the plasticity layer (E0) and the switching layer (E2) and re-derives neither. Mania and depression are two operating poles on ONE valence axis (the M17 approach/M18 cortisol geometry); an episode is a bistable transition (E2 hysteresis+latency, persists past its trigger); kindling is the E0 trace accumulating across episodes (‖ΔW‖ 0.06→0.33, each switch easier); the mood-stabiliser sign is barrier-raising (flip threshold 0.38→0.64). η=0 reproduces the frozen M9 anchor bit-for-bit. Heterogeneity locked; addiction (T3a) owed. efficacy=0; not medical advice.

chapters.one_liner: Applies the SAME threshold-shift intervention logic as §30/§31 (inherited from the analgesic reproducibility package, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.20733420) to §27's low-coordination pole, and is the FIRST L3-DOMINANT case: §27 proved major depression is the chronification of an operating point with R below health (a sustained HPA-driven withdrawal) and that the corrective sign is to RESTORE the deficient drive, but treated that push as ONE abstract operator. chapters.title: Autism threshold levers — the E/I over-excitation operating-point correction decomposed into DNA-grounded levers
chapters.one_liner: Applies the SAME threshold-shift intervention logic as §30/§31/§32/§33 (inherited from the analgesic reproducibility package, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.20733420) to the §18-19 autism E/I over-excitation pole, and is the UNIFICATION case: rather than introducing a new lever combination it re-expresses the pre-existing autism_multilever_threshold.py (which carried the idea under informal A1/A2/A3 levers) under the formal L1/L2/L3 frame. §18-19 proved autism is NOT one axis but three distinct fault axes — T (excitability / E-I threshold, an over-excitation operating point whose ignition fold sits too low), O (synaptic output / gain deficit), W (long-range wiring / connectivity) — that only the T axis is reachable by a scalar chemical lever (corrective sign: reduce the excess drive / restore inhibition, same direction as epilepsy / schizophrenia-positive), and (§19) that the W axis is PROVABLY unreachable (a threshold shift can only MASK a wiring fault by over-synchronisation — the seizure analogue, P5_threshold_lowering_is_mask_not_correction — never CORRECT it, P4_chemical_cannot_fix_W). This chapter DECOMPOSES the T-axis correction into a three-lever target map on the SAME R19 substrate, no new mechanism or tuned constant. Autism is the 5th distribution pattern across the series: L1-DOMINANT with a nearly-empty L3. Of 10 lever genes, 5 sit on L1 (the excitatory-reduce axis: GRIN2A, GRIN2B, GRIA1, SCN2A, CACNA1C), 4 on L2 (the inhibitory-restore axis: KCNQ3 M-current K+, GABRB3, GABRA5, GABRA2), and just 1 on L3 (SLC6A4, a cautious non-monotone serotonergic node graded [O]) — the L3-sparsity is itself the finding, that autism's actionable biology sits locally on the E/I set with no clean up-stream drug drive (the mirror of depression's L3-dominance). TWO structural strengthenings beyond the schizophrenia domain-restriction template: (1) the OUT-OF-REACH axes are NAMED with six real genes — O (output deficit) = SHANK3, SYNGAP1, NRXN1; W (long-range wiring) = CNTNAP2, RELN; plus the syndromic master MECP2 — carried on the map but explicitly NOT levers; (2) the W-axis unreachability is PROVEN, not asserted (§19). Seven reads (GRIN2A/GRIN2B/CACNA1C/GABRB3 from the schizophrenia cache, SCN2A/KCNQ3 from the bipolar cache, SLC6A4 from the depression cache) reuse the promoter caches verbatim (γ strand-symmetric). Two honest caveats: SCN2A and GRIN2B are GoF/LoF SIGN-SUBTLE (gain-of-function → early DEE/seizure pole; loss-of-function → milder ASD/ID pole — opposite directions), and the T lever pushed TOO HARD is itself the seizure edge (the real ASD+epilepsy comorbidity) — hence γ is [V] for promoter STRUCTURE only, clinical direction [O]. Each gene placed by its own promoter switch stiffness γ→|h_sp| (SantaLucia 1998, engine read-only); across all 16 genes the decoupling names itself — the stiffest reads are the out-of-reach SHANK3/RELN and the sparse L3 SLC6A4, the softest are the actionable E/I levers SCN2A/CACNA1C (stiffness runs OPPOSITE to reachability). Fail-closed L3-honesty gate (asserts L1 UNIQUE dominance, L3 SPARSITY, the T-axis restriction, and the NAMED + §19-proven O/W out-of-reach axes) + forbidden-claim scanner — the strictest in the series, adding an autism QUACKERY class (chelation / MMS / bleach protocols) and a NORMALISE-framing class protecting neurodiversity respect (autism is a DIFFERENCE, not only a deficit) — + burden-weighted ranking of the 10 LEVER genes only (the AUTISM unmet-need signature: no approved core-feature pharmacology → U uniformly high, no DRD2-analogue lowering it; the L2 inhibitory-restore route GABRB3/GABRA5/KCNQ3/GABRA2 surfaces as the cleanest ACTIONABLE direction because the high-scoring L1 excitatory genes are GoF/LoF sign-subtle — restoring inhibition raises the fold regardless of variant direction), γ carried as context but never folded into the score; decoupling witness: stiffest lever read SLC6A4 ranks LAST and non-actionable, top-priority GABRB3 reads mid-range (firewall: promoter |h_sp| ≠ §18 network over-excitation threshold on R ≠ receptor occupancy / synaptic level / potency / dose / clinical effect). Registered as 12th atlas citizen (ASD-T-L), reproduces bit-for-bit, engine byte-unchanged. efficacy=0; targets ranked, never drugs; autism is a difference, not only a deficit; not medical advice.

chapters.title: ADHD threshold levers — the drive-tone / arousal operating-point correction decomposed into DNA-grounded levers (L3-only; first partial fit)
chapters.one_liner: Applies the SAME threshold-shift intervention logic as §30/§31/§32/§33/§34 (inherited from the analgesic reproducibility package, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.20733420) to the §22 adhd_axis_specific substrate (ADHD = gain/arousal with INTACT WIRING: six output/gain genes, two arousal/threshold genes, ZERO wiring genes; FOXP2/ADGRL3 pre-registered out), and is the FIRST PARTIAL [L] fit in the series. The fit is PARTIAL [L] for a two-sided reason: (1) the DOMINANT axis is OUT OF REACH — ADHD is a gain/arousal disorder not a firing-FOLD disorder, so the drive-tone lever reaches only the SECONDARY drive-tone surface and NOT the GA gain-amplitude machinery (synthesis/release), which is the dominant fault, NAMED with four real genes (TH/DBH synthesis, SNAP25 release, COMT catabolic clearance boundary) carried with γ alongside but graded [F] NOT REACHED; (2) the frame has NO structural [F] grounding (L1/L2 empty, only the [O] drive surface). This is the precise INVERSE of autism: autism reached its DOMINANT axis and missed O+W; ADHD reaches only the SECONDARY axis and misses the DOMINANT axis, with no W. Six reads (SLC6A3/DRD4/SLC6A4/TH/COMT from the depression/schizophrenia caches) reuse the caches verbatim (γ strand-symmetric); ADRA2A/DBH/SNAP25 are live GRCh38 strand-aware reads. chapters.title: Alzheimer's threshold levers — the cholinergic / glutamatergic / network symptomatic operating-point correction decomposed into DNA-grounded levers (third & deepest partial fit)

The PROG axis is NAMED with six real genes carried with γ alongside but graded [F] NOT REACHED. Five reads (GRIN2A/GRIN2B/GABRA5/GABRB3 from the autism cache, GABRA1 from the epilepsy cache) reuse the caches verbatim (γ strand-symmetric); the ten cholinergic/progression genes (ACHE/BCHE/CHRNA7/CHRM1/APP/PSEN1/PSEN2/MAPT/APOE/TREM2) are live GRCh38 strand-aware reads. The DNA reads carry a decoupling ORTHOGONAL to reach (like addiction): the three STIFFEST promoters (CHRM1/ACHE/CHRNA7) are all reachable cholinergic levers, the two SOFTEST (BCHE/GABRA1) are ALSO reachable, and the six out-of-reach PROG genes cluster in the MIDDLE — so stiffness predicts neither axis nor reach. Fail-closed L3-honesty gate (asserts L3 dominance, L1>0 AND L2>0, the SPLIT symptomatic sign, the PROG-axis named-out-of-reach, and the PARTIAL [L] grade) + forbidden-claim scanner adding TWO dementia-topic classes — CURE_REVERSAL (reverse/cure/prevent/halt-progression/restore-lost-memory/regrow-neurons/miracle-cure) and DIGNITY (empty-shell/no-longer-a-person/vegetable/already-gone/not-worth-treating), both negation-guarded with planted self-tests — + burden-weighted ranking of all 15 targets, γ carried as context but never folded into the score. Five of twelve reads are carried VERBATIM from the depression/addiction/autism/epilepsy caches (gamma is strand-symmetric); the seven new genes are live GRCh38 strand-aware reads. Registered as the 18th atlas citizen (OCD-T3c-L), reproduces bit-for-bit, engine byte-unchanged. efficacy=0; targets ranked, never drugs or doses; not medical advice; the reachable levers genuinely but partially help and do not unstick the loop; OCD is a treatable medical condition and intrusive thoughts are a symptom, not a moral failing; consciousness_claim=0; hard problem OPEN.
